summary: Flat-to-tiny start to the week everywhere, then an SE swell fills in Wednesday and holds through the weekend. Rockaway handles it fine — Wednesday's decent and Sunday's prime-angle 3-4ft with cross-off wind makes the home break enough — but Thursday's clean offshore prime session at Manasquan is the one drive worth making. Weekend outlook: Sunday's the biggest across the board yet windy at most spots, so Rockaway and offshore Matunuck are your cleanest bets.
